Use the rhoCentralFoam solver (density-based central-scheme compressible) in system/controlDict.
Treat air as a perfect gas using hePsiThermo with equationOfState perfectGas and transport sutherland in constant/thermophysicalProperties.
The mesh is a 2D cross-section extruded exactly one cell in the z-direction; the frontAndBack patches are set to empty in blockMeshDict and carry no boundary conditions.
The domain is a 200 mm (streamwise, x) by 100 mm (transverse, y) by 1 mm (z) rectangular box.
The jet inlet is a 10 mm high section centered on the left (x = 0) face, spanning y = 45 mm to y = 55 mm.
The remaining portions of the left face (y = 0 to 45 mm and y = 55 mm to 100 mm) are noSlip walls.
The right face (x = 200 mm) is the far-field outlet.
The top face (y = 100 mm) and bottom face (y = 0 mm) are noSlip adiabatic walls.
The mesh is uniform with 400 cells in x, 200 cells in y, and 1 cell in z, giving 80,000 total cells.
Inlet boundary conditions on the 10 mm section: fixedValue for rho (1.184 kg/m3), fixedValue for U (686 0 0 m/s), fixedValue for e (215400 J/kg), corresponding to p = 101325 Pa, T = 300 K, Mach 2.0.
Outlet boundary conditions on the right face: waveTransmissive for p with pAmbient 101325, waveTransmissive for e with eAmbient 215400, zeroGradient for U.
Wall boundary conditions on all noSlip surfaces (top, bottom, and left-face wall portions): noSlip for U, zeroGradient for rho, zeroGradient for e (adiabatic).
Use the Spalart-Allmaras RANS turbulence model configured in constant/turbulenceProperties, with the nuTilda field initialized to a small value (e.g., 1e-6 m2/s) throughout the domain.
Initial field values in the domain (outside the inlet): rho = 1.184 kg/m3, U = (0 0 0) m/s, e = 215400 J/kg, representing quiescent air at 101325 Pa and 300 K.
Time stepping is explicit with a maximum CFL number of 0.5 set in system/controlDict.
The end time is 0.01 s, which allows the jet to fully traverse and develop within the 200 mm domain.
Set the application in system/controlDict to rhoCentralFoam.
